svg.aria-label: Choosing a server. Round robin sends requests to servers in turn, which is fine when requests cost the same. Least connections sends the next request to the server with the fewest active requests, which adapts when some requests are slow. Consistent hashing on a key such as user ID sends the same key to the same server, which keeps its cache warm or its WebSocket session in one place. Power of two choices picks two servers at random and uses the less loaded one, which is cheap and avoids herding.
